change.says: A change needs the current wallet AND the new one, then a 1-day wait the payer can cancel. An email or a new key alone can't do it.

pay.firstRun: escalate: This is the first payment to this payee's address, so the contract won't pay it until a person co-signs. Please confirm the address with the payee, then co-sign.
pay.secondRun: pay: Passes every rule, and a person co-signed this exact claim.

claims.what: The same work billed again under a new invoice number
claims.agent: hold: The payee says this is a resend of the same design work. You already paid 0.05 USDC for invoice INV-DEMO-9B40EA, so paying this one would pay for the same work twice.

claims.what: A large claim with no description of the work
claims.contract: ESCALATED: Above the co-sign threshold for this period.
claims.agent: escalate: This claim is over the limit where a person must co-sign. It is also 8 times this payee's only past payment, and its dates overlap their other claims.

claims.what: A 'new wallet' request with a hidden instruction to the AI
claims.agent: escalate: The description asks for payment to a new wallet today, and it has hidden text telling me to skip approval. Both are warning signs of fraud, so please confirm with the payee through a contact you already trust before paying.
